subject: Unauthorized Service Fee on Monthly Telecom Statement
description: An extra $14.99 premium voicemail addon charge was billed without authorization or opt-in consent.

timeline.remarks: Billing dispute submitted.
Billing team auditing provisioning history.

subject: Cold Water Only in Community Gym Shower Facility
description: Showers 1 through 4 have zero hot water supply since Monday morning early bird hours.

timeline.remarks: Water heater failure reported by morning runners.

subject: Faulty Power Supply on Workstation Pro 9
description: The desktop power supply began making loud buzzing noises and repeatedly shuts down under GPU rendering load.

timeline.remarks: Reported hardware failure with audio clip.
Replacement 850W modular PSU dispatched to field tech.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: Field engineering scheduled for Tuesday 10:00 AM.

subject: Defective Display Cable on Projector
description: HDMI output cuts out every few minutes during lecture hall presentations.

timeline.remarks: Complaint filed successfully into the tracker.
Assigned AV specialist to inspect projector cable.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: Replacement braided HDMI 2.1 cable ordered from distributor.

subject: Damaged Smart Thermostat Received
description: Received the EcoTemp 400 thermostat package with a cracked front display and severed wiring harness. Order placed on Oct 18.

timeline.remarks: Complaint filed with product unboxing photos.
Assigned to Hardware Quality & RMA team.
Replacement unit dispatched under RMA-5510.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: RMA approved. Courier tracking label sent to customer email.

subject: Duplicate Subscription Billing for October
description: My credit card was charged twice on October 1st for the Pro Cloud storage annual plan ($119.88 x 2). Requesting immediate refund of the duplicate charge.

timeline.remarks: Complaint filed with duplicate bank statement extract.
Verified double capture in payment gateway logs.
Refund request transmitted to Stripe merchant account.
Refund of $119.88 cleared successfully. Acquirer reference sent to customer.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: Card issuer confirmation received. Settlement confirmed.

subject: Flickering Light and Exposed Wiring in Building B Stairwell
description: The overhead emergency lighting on the 3rd-floor landing of Stairwell B is constantly flickering and wires are dangling from the conduit fixture.

timeline.remarks: Urgent hazard report lodged.
Flagged as high-priority safety risk. Notified evening maintenance.
Electrical contractor dispatched to isolate breaker and rewire ballast.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: Caution tape placed around landing. Breaker 4B turned off pending repair.

subject: Unprofessional Conduct by Front Desk Representative
description: When asking for assistance regarding service scheduling, the attendant dismissed my inquiries rudely and refused to provide their badge identification.

timeline.remarks: Complaint filed with timestamp of occurrence (1:45 PM).
Forwarded to Customer Relations Director for staff duty shift logs.

subject: Package Left in Rain Without Protection
description: Courier driver dumped electronics carton on the uncovered driveway during torrential downpour instead of covered porch 5 feet away. Outer carton soaked.

timeline.remarks: Submitted with delivery photos.

subject: Student Portal 502 Bad Gateway Error During Course Registration
description: Attempting to confirm enrollment throws 502 Bad Gateway intermittently between 9:00 AM and 11:30 AM. Session drops all selected courses.

timeline.remarks: Reported with browser console HAR file.
DevOps identified connection pool exhaustion on replica DB.
Scaled Kubernetes pods and increased pool max connections from 50 to 250.
Gateway stabilized. Zero drops observed in APM dashboards.

subject: HVAC Unit Leaking Water in Conference Room 204
description: Condensation drip from ceiling mounted HVAC vent has damaged acoustic tiles and carpet in Room 204. Bucket placed underneath as interim stopgap.

timeline.remarks: Filed during team weekly sync.
Scheduled facilities inspection for 2 PM today.

subject: Warranty Claim Rejected Erroneously
description: Submitted proof of purchase for espresso machine pump failure within 12-month manufacturer window, but customer support denied claim citing invalid serial number.

timeline.remarks: Attached photo of serial number plate and original receipt.
Found serial number OCR mismatch in automated scan system.
Manual override applied. Warranty status updated to Active.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: Authorized service center dispatch voucher issued.

subject: Missing Noise Cancellation Ear Tips in Retail Box
description: Purchased ProAudio Earbuds from the flagship store yesterday. The accessory pouch only had small tips, medium and large silicone tips were missing.

timeline.remarks: Complaint filed online.

subject: Non-Refundable Fee Charged on Cancelled Flight
description: Flight was cancelled by the carrier due to maintenance, yet convenience fee of $35 per passenger was withheld from the refund credit.

timeline.remarks: Complaint submitted requesting remaining balance refund.
Reviewed against terms of service clause 14.2.
Travel insurance voucher of equal value was accepted by user at check-out in lieu of cash convenience fee refund.

comments.author: Admin (admin)
comments.text: Policy documented and explanation delivered to passenger.

subject: Cafeteria Sanitizer Dispensers Empty for 3 Days
description: All three touchless hand sanitizing stations at the main cafeteria entrance have had flashing red refill lights since Wednesday.

timeline.remarks: Hygiene complaint logged.
Janitorial team notified.
Refilled all 3 dispenser cartridges with gel sanitizer.

subject: Missing Community Recycling Bins at Parking Lot D
description: The mixed paper and plastic recycling bins were removed during asphalt resurfacing last month and have not been restored.

timeline.remarks: Civic request filed.
